resolved_findings.original_finding: Registry can omit existing required policy.
resolved_findings.resolution: Registry membership must exactly match preserved fixed-directory versioned policy files. Empty is accepted only when no such files exist.

resolved_findings.original_finding: UID-less proof inherits policy UID and permits reassociation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Top-level proof must explicitly identify the policy study. Historical UID-less native reviews remain immutable and require a source/report/UID-bound wrapper whose preserved review binds the exact handoff content.

additional_verified_behaviors: Excluded quarantine neighbor remains quarantined with the same leakage group and preserved annotations while report masks are zero.
Official gold values, masks, provenance and split remain intact for excluded and eligible rows.
Report-versus-gold metrics count only eligible reports; mixed eligible/ineligible fixture retains the eligible true negative and suppresses excluded false positive.
Broken policy membership or source/report wrapper binding rejects before output directory creation.

verification.scope: Synthetic fixtures only. No real gold labels or clinical annotations inspected. Parent reported full suite success separately; this acceptance records personally executed targeted regression verification.

limitations: This is code and synthetic regression acceptance, not a new acceptance of clinical labels or every real policy/evidence artifact.
No runtime or policy files changed during re-review; only assigned test file was edited previously.
